main_body: Square hay bale seen face-on: a golden straw block with a vertical dark brown binding strap down the middle, a darker olive-brown border, and a grid of straw texture dots.
top_band: none. The column through the middle (x~8) meets the dark brown border at rows ~2-3, then straw tone, then the strap. No distinct lighter top band separated from the front face by an edge line.
evidence: The bale is a single flat square of straw from about row 3 to row 14. It has a uniform border and a vertical strap, but no horizontal top surface foreshortened above a front face. The upper rows have the same straw tone as the face, and the only mark at the top is a 1-2px dark border. This reads as a front elevation, or as a top-down plan of a bale, not a 3/4 box. There is no front-edge highlight, no eave shadow and no inset detail.

style.evidence: The straw has about 3 tones (light straw, mid straw, darker straw dots) plus a dark brown strap and border. The border is a dark brown tint, not near-black, which is correct. The texture is a sparse dot pattern on the straw, so the surface is not fully flat. However, it is far shallower than the references, which have 5-6 steps per material, per-element highlights and dense tiles. Most tiles carry only about 3-5 colours, so density is much lower than the reference.
